| File | Title | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `manners-prompt.png` | Buff them back in one click | Somebody buffed you; one click buffs them back. Shown as your buff lands. |
| `manners-moment.png` | Three moments | Film strips of one favour, four frames each: somebody buffs you, your buff lands, the game refuses it. Frames at 0.05, 0.15, 0.30 and 0.60 seconds. |
| `manners-reasons.png` | Why somebody is on the prompt | Your target, somebody who buffed you, somebody who asked in chat, your group, and passers-by missing your buff -- each in its own colour, offered in that order. |
| `manners-list.png` | Click any name | Switch on List the next few below (Look) and every name under the prompt is a button, with the icon of the buff they would get. Left-click buffs that person, right-click skips them for now, shift-right-click never offers them again. |
| `manners-yourself.png` | Your own buffs too | When your own armor, poison or buff is missing, you come up on the prompt as "You": a mage's armor, a rogue's poison for the main hand, your own Arcane Intellect. |
| `manners-options.png` | Set it up in one window | Open it with /manners or the minimap button. Shown on Who to buff for a paladin with a buff order of its own, and Move the prompt one click away in the header. |
| `manners-looks.png` | Nine looks to choose from | Luxe, Toast, Arcane, Ribbon, Letter, Leather, Glass, Framed and Minimal, the same favour drawn in each; click a card under Look to switch. |
| `manners-ledger.png` | The favour ledger | Who buffed you, whether you returned it, and who you buffed without being asked. Open it with /manners ledger. |
| `manners-languages.png` | In your language | English and eight translations, chosen by your game client. Shown here in German, French and Simplified Chinese. |
| `manners-palette.png` | A palette for colour blindness | The five reason colours redrawn for red-green colour blindness, one setting away under Look > Style. |
